description: Extended Events Profiler (xEvents) is unsupported in Iridium. The TDS probes it emits are stub entries for the differential harness; no live replay is exercised.
status_note: Iridium does not support Extended Events. The Profiler UI should be disabled in the vscode-mssql extension via capability probes (SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion') indicates >= 16.0 but sys.dm_xe_sessions is empty).
